\begin{theorem}[Critical mixing and functional inequalities]

For every fixed $\varepsilon\in(0,1/2)$, in probability over the Gaussian

\begin{align*}

$\delta>0$, $\Pprob\{n^{a-\delta}\le X_n\le n^{a+\delta}\}\to1$.
\end{theorem}
